# Isaiah Chapter 62 -- The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

*[Full dynamic translation of all 12 verses in natural contemporary English]*

*Not silent for Zion; new name; no more Forsaken; watchmen on walls; prepare the way*

---

## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

**Zion's New Name:** Not silent for Zion; new name; no more Forsaken; watchmen on walls; prepare the way. The key message for modern readers: "You shall be called by a new name that the mouth of the LORD will give"

*-- PNEUMA*
